stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS via College Navigator (fall 2024 entering class); no Common Data Set could be found on UNCG's institutional research site. Admits is derived from the reported 89% admit rate (12,948 x 0.89, so approximate); enrolled is left empty (College Navigator gives only 'percent admitted who enrolled', 21%). Only 48 enrollees submitted SAT and 232 ACT, so the score percentiles describe a small group. SAT total, GPA, residency/international splits are not available. Applicant/admit/enrolled counts replaced with exact IPEDS ADM2023 (fall 2023) figures, because the newer source gives only a rounded admit rate.

cost.notes: College Navigator estimated expenses for beginning undergraduates, 2024-25: tuition and fees in-state $7,661, out-of-state $24,012; books $850; on-campus food and housing $10,688; other $3,386. The current-cycle cost block (2026-27) overrides these.
